deduplication_audit.interpretation: Repeated normalized DOI/URL identities are deterministic duplicate records for the current PRISMA flow. The raw title metric includes rows in those identity groups; title_only is recalculated after identity removal. Title-only matches remain candidates for semantic review and are not removed automatically.

candidate_audit.interpretation: The operational candidate count is the current included set plus the persisted manual-audit overrides. These overrides are not scientific exclusion findings until adjudicated, and are not an extra PRISMA stage.

operational_database_snapshot.interpretation: This block records the unversioned SQLite state available when the manifest was generated. It is diagnostic only and is not the current PRISMA baseline; use the versioned snapshot object and summary.json for the current adjudicated population.

protocol.interpretation: These parameters describe the protocol contract for a fresh run. External API responses, cache state and metadata may change; they do not replace the current versioned snapshot exports.

deduplication_audit.interpretation: Exact normalized DOI/URL identity rows are removed deterministically from the PRISMA flow; normalized-title counts remain weaker candidates for semantic review because versioned records and unrelated works must remain distinct. The title metric includes identity-overlap rows; title_only is calculated after deterministic identity removal.

candidate_audit.interpretation: The 23-record candidate universe is preserved as historical context: 16 operationally retained records plus seven manual overrides. The current selection is divided into 15 empirical studies, 1 record excluded after abstract screening, 1 full-text report not retrieved, and 1 protocol excluded after full-text assessment. These categories describe distinct stages; the preliminary list is not equivalent to the empirical included set or an additional PRISMA stage.

manual_override_adjudication.interpretation: The ledger records evidence and proposed scope rationales for the persisted overrides; it does not replace supervisor adjudication.

manual_override_evidence_matrix.interpretation: The matrix records source-supported scope signals and required actions. It is evidence for adjudication, not a final inclusion or exclusion decision.

bibliography.separation_rule: The BibTeX inventory contains 18 records in the preliminary list; 15 are currently included in the empirical core. Methodological, pedagogical, assessment and technical references are external to the pipeline study set and remain in the complete TCC bibliography.

blocking_reasons: The empirical corpus retains 15 studies provisionally; 14 have MMAT screening responses and 11 have category-specific appraisals. These counts are not final eligibility decisions.

methodological_appraisal.interpretation: The current MMAT ledger records S1/S2 screening for 14 studies and category-specific appraisal for 11; three screened studies await design adjudication and have blank Q1-Q5 cells, not CT. 15 records remain provisionally in the empirical corpus; study 8 has no MMAT responses pending human scope and appraisal-unit adjudication, and its distinct datasets must not be combined. MMAT has not been applied to the 1 unretrieved shortlisted report. Incomplete source retrieval or pending methodological adjudication blocks any final quality claim. Historical reviewer labels do not establish completed human reading or appraisal; human verification remains pending.
